name: Heterogeneous Volumetric Raymarching
definition: A rendering technique for participating media (clouds, fog, godrays) that uses delta tracking and ratio tracking on density fields instead of sphere tracing on distance, allowing for heterogeneous (non-uniform) density distributions.
summary: Heterogeneous Volumetric Raymarching renders participating media with non-uniform density by using delta and ratio tracking on density fields instead of distance-based sphere tracing.
